risk_if_not_implemented: Without Remote Maintenance Cryptographic Protection, data in transit and at rest may be exposed through weak, misconfigured or compromised cryptographic protections. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), Loss of Data Integrity (R-IP-3), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Harvest Now / Decrypt Later (HNDL) (MT-28), Cryptographic Compromise / Cryptanalytic Capability Advancement (MT-31).

compensating_control_1.name: Non-Console Administrative Access
compensating_control_1.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to protect the confidentiality and integrity of non-console administrative access.
compensating_control_1.justification: Non-Console Administrative Access (CFG-04.7) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Remote Maintenance Cryptographic Protection (MNT-12.4) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Remote Maintenance
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to authorize, monitor and control remote, non-local maintenance and diagnostic activities.
compensating_control_2.justification: Remote Maintenance (MNT-12) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Remote Maintenance Cryptographic Protection (MNT-12.4) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Data applicability. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
